summary: Submitted an explore operation (harness: probe_config_publish_test.go) that reduces the two recorded gaps for candidate 0a6d446a083a42cf91e99726f577eaea. Gap 2 (recovery path) closed with a new in-package Go test: after a transient LogStore.StoreLogs failure made AddVoter(phantom) install a two-voter latest while the durable log still ended at index 2, the node was shut down and a fresh Raft was built from the same durable store and snapshot store. Observed CA_EVENT restart_after_failed_durable_write: servers_before_restart lists the real voter plus phantom/phantom-addr/Voter, while servers_after_restart lists exactly one voter and became_leader_after=true (commit index 3) - so the durable log, not the published configuration, is the recovered truth, and restart is a working recovery path. The same run bounds the running-process behaviour (CA_EVENT progress_after_failed_durable_write: state Candidate, ever_leader_in_window=false over 141 samples, quorum_size_live=2, reachable voters 1) and source reasoning explains why nothing self-repairs: the only running paths that revert configurations.latest to the committed value are the appendEntries truncation branch (raft.go:1530) and installSnapshot (raft.go:1937), and both need a leader while no leader can be elected against an unreachable voter. Gap 1 (no-error reachability) is answered as a sourced negative result plus a success-path control: CA_EVENT config_persist_success_control shows AddVoter error nil, getlog_at_assigned_idx_err nil for assigned index 4 and durable_last_index_after=4, so when the write succeeds the published two-voter configuration has a durable counterpart; and enumerating all publishing sites shows appendConfigurationEntry (raft.go:1203-1240, call at raft.go:1237) is the only site that can install a configuration absent from the log, since truncation reverts to the committed configuration (raft.go:1530), processConfigurationLogEntry installs the configuration of an entry just stored or read from the log (raft.go:1585-1600), installSnapshot installs the received snapshot configuration (raft.go:1937), and startup restore installs the snapshot configuration (api.go:664). The injected StoreLogs failure and the unreachable phantom address are explicitly supplied preconditions, not produced by real producers. Preflight validation returned valid true. No source, evidence, credential or dependency files were modified; only draft/submission.json and draft/probe_config_publish_test.go changed.
